scripts.dev: npm run services:up && concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend-user" "npm run dev:frontend-admin"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend-user && npm install && cd ../frontend-admin && npm install
scripts.build:all: cd backend && npm run build && cd ../frontend-user && npm run build && cd ../frontend-admin && npm run build
